short_description: Manage bits and pieces of XML files or strings

params.name: add_children
params.description: Add additional child-element(s) to a selected element for a given O(xpath). Child elements must be given in a list and each item may be either a string (for example C(children=ansible) to add an empty C(<ansible/>) child element), or a hash where the key is an element name and the value is the element value. This parameter requires O(xpath) to be set.

params.name: attribute
params.description: The attribute to select when using parameter O(value). This is a string, not prepended with V(@).

params.name: backup
params.description: Create a backup file including the timestamp information so you can get the original file back if you somehow clobbered it incorrectly.

params.name: content
params.description: Search for a given O(xpath) and get content. This parameter requires O(xpath) to be set.

params.name: count
params.description: Search for a given O(xpath) and provide the count of any matches. This parameter requires O(xpath) to be set.

params.name: input_type
params.description: Type of input for O(add_children) and O(set_children).

params.name: insertafter
params.description: Add additional child-element(s) after the last selected element for a given O(xpath). Child elements must be given in a list and each item may be either a string (for example C(children=ansible) to add an empty C(<ansible/>) child element), or a hash where the key is an element name and the value is the element value. This parameter requires O(xpath) to be set.

params.name: insertbefore
params.description: Add additional child-element(s) before the first selected element for a given O(xpath). Child elements must be given in a list and each item may be either a string (for example C(children=ansible) to add an empty C(<ansible/>) child element), or a hash where the key is an element name and the value is the element value. This parameter requires O(xpath) to be set.

params.name: namespaces
params.description: The namespace C(prefix:uri) mapping for the XPath expression. Needs to be a C(dict), not a C(list) of items.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the file to operate on. This file must exist ahead of time. This parameter is required, unless O(xmlstring) is given.

params.name: pretty_print
params.description: Pretty print XML output.

params.name: print_match
params.description: Search for a given O(xpath) and print out any matches. This parameter requires O(xpath) to be set.

params.name: set_children
params.description: Set the child-element(s) of a selected element for a given O(xpath). Removes any existing children. Child elements must be specified as in O(add_children). This parameter requires O(xpath) to be set.

params.name: state
params.description: Set or remove an xpath selection (node(s), attribute(s)).

params.name: strip_cdata_tags
params.description: Remove CDATA tags surrounding text values. Note that this might break your XML file if text values contain characters that could be interpreted as XML.

params.name: value
params.description: Desired state of the selected attribute. Either a string, or to unset a value, the Python V(None) keyword (YAML Equivalent, V(null)). Elements default to no value (but present). Attributes default to an empty string.

params.name: xmlstring
params.description: A string containing XML on which to operate. This parameter is required, unless O(path) is given.

params.name: xpath
params.description: A valid XPath expression describing the item(s) you want to manipulate. Operates on the document root, V(/), by default.

name: community.general.yarn
short_description: Manage node.js packages with Yarn

params.name: executable
params.description: The executable location for yarn.

params.name: global
params.description: Install the node.js library globally

params.name: ignore_scripts
params.description: Use the --ignore-scripts flag when installing.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of a node.js library to install If omitted all packages in package.json are installed. To globally install from local node.js library. Prepend "file:" to the path of the node.js library.

params.name: path
params.description: The base path where Node.js libraries will be installed. This is where the node_modules folder lives.

params.name: production
params.description: Install dependencies in production mode. Yarn will ignore any dependencies under devDependencies in package.json

params.name: registry
params.description: The registry to install modules from.

params.name: state
params.description: Installation state of the named node.js library If absent is selected, a name option must be provided

params.name: version
params.description: The version of the library to be installed. Must be in semver format. If "latest" is desired, use "state" arg instead

name: ansible.builtin.yum
short_description: Manages packages with the I(yum) package manager

params.name: allow_downgrade
params.description: Specify if the named package and version is allowed to downgrade a maybe already installed higher version of that package. Note that setting allow_downgrade=True can make this module behave in a non-idempotent way. The task could end up with a set of packages that does not match the complete list of specified packages to install (because dependencies between the downgraded package and others can cause changes to the packages which were in the earlier transaction).

params.name: autoremove
params.description: If V(true), removes all "leaf" packages from the system that were originally installed as dependencies of user-installed packages but which are no longer required by any such package. Should be used alone or when O(state) is V(absent) NOTE: This feature requires yum >= 3.4.3 (RHEL/CentOS 7+)

params.name: bugfix
params.description: If set to V(true), and O(state=latest) then only installs updates that have been marked bugfix related.

params.name: cacheonly
params.description: Tells yum to run entirely from system cache; does not download or update metadata.

params.name: conf_file
params.description: The remote yum configuration file to use for the transaction.

params.name: disable_excludes
params.description: Disable the excludes defined in YUM config files. If set to V(all), disables all excludes. If set to V(main), disable excludes defined in [main] in yum.conf. If set to V(repoid), disable excludes defined for given repo id.

params.name: disable_gpg_check
params.description: Whether to disable the GPG checking of signatures of packages being installed. Has an effect only if O(state) is V(present) or V(latest).

params.name: disable_plugin
params.description: I(Plugin) name to disable for the install/update operation. The disabled plugins will not persist beyond the transaction.

params.name: disablerepo
params.description: I(Repoid) of repositories to disable for the install/update operation. These repos will not persist beyond the transaction. When specifying multiple repos, separate them with a C(","). As of Ansible 2.7, this can alternatively be a list instead of C(",") separated string

params.name: download_dir
params.description: Specifies an alternate directory to store packages. Has an effect only if O(download_only) is specified.

params.name: download_only
params.description: Only download the packages, do not install them.

params.name: enable_plugin
params.description: I(Plugin) name to enable for the install/update operation. The enabled plugin will not persist beyond the transaction.

params.name: enablerepo
params.description: I(Repoid) of repositories to enable for the install/update operation. These repos will not persist beyond the transaction. When specifying multiple repos, separate them with a C(","). As of Ansible 2.7, this can alternatively be a list instead of C(",") separated string

params.name: exclude
params.description: Package name(s) to exclude when state=present, or latest

params.name: install_repoquery
params.description: If repoquery is not available, install yum-utils. If the system is registered to RHN or an RHN Satellite, repoquery allows for querying all channels assigned to the system. It is also required to use the 'list' parameter. NOTE: This will run and be logged as a separate yum transation which takes place before any other installation or removal. NOTE: This will use the system's default enabled repositories without regard for disablerepo/enablerepo given to the module.

params.name: install_weak_deps
params.description: Will also install all packages linked by a weak dependency relation. NOTE: This feature requires yum >= 4 (RHEL/CentOS 8+)

params.name: installroot
params.description: Specifies an alternative installroot, relative to which all packages will be installed.

params.name: list
params.description: Package name to run the equivalent of C(yum list --show-duplicates <package>) against. In addition to listing packages, use can also list the following: V(installed), V(updates), V(available) and V(repos). This parameter is mutually exclusive with O(name).

params.name: lock_timeout
params.description: Amount of time to wait for the yum lockfile to be freed.

params.name: name
params.description: A package name or package specifier with version, like V(name-1.0). Comparison operators for package version are valid here C(>), C(<), C(>=), C(<=). Example - V(name>=1.0) If a previous version is specified, the task also needs to turn O(allow_downgrade) on. See the O(allow_downgrade) documentation for caveats with downgrading packages. When using O(state=latest), this can be V('*') which means run C(yum -y update). You can also pass a url or a local path to an rpm file (using O(state=present)). To operate on several packages this can accept a comma separated string of packages or (as of 2.0) a list of packages.

params.name: releasever
params.description: Specifies an alternative release from which all packages will be installed.

params.name: security
params.description: If set to V(true), and O(state=latest) then only installs updates that have been marked security related.

params.name: skip_broken
params.description: Skip all unavailable packages or packages with broken dependencies without raising an error. Equivalent to passing the --skip-broken option.

params.name: sslverify
params.description: Disables SSL validation of the repository server for this transaction. This should be set to V(false) if one of the configured repositories is using an untrusted or self-signed certificate.

params.name: state
params.description: Whether to install (V(present) or V(installed), V(latest)), or remove (V(absent) or V(removed)) a package. V(present) and V(installed) will simply ensure that a desired package is installed. V(latest) will update the specified package if it's not of the latest available version. V(absent) and V(removed) will remove the specified package. Default is V(None), however in effect the default action is V(present) unless the O(autoremove) option is enabled for this module, then V(absent) is inferred.

params.name: update_cache
params.description: Force yum to check if cache is out of date and redownload if needed. Has an effect only if O(state) is V(present) or V(latest).

params.name: update_only
params.description: When using latest, only update installed packages. Do not install packages. Has an effect only if O(state) is V(latest)

params.name: use_backend
params.description: This module supports V(yum) (as it always has), this is known as C(yum3)/C(YUM3)/C(yum-deprecated) by upstream yum developers. As of Ansible 2.7+, this module also supports C(YUM4), which is the "new yum" and it has an V(dnf) backend. As of ansible-core 2.15+, this module will auto select the backend based on the C(ansible_pkg_mgr) fact. By default, this module will select the backend based on the C(ansible_pkg_mgr) fact.

params.name: validate_certs
params.description: This only applies if using a https url as the source of the rpm. e.g. for localinstall. If set to V(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to V(false) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates as it avoids verifying the source site. Prior to 2.1 the code worked as if this was set to V(true).

name: yum
short_description: Ensure one or more RPM packages are present, absent, or upgraded to the latest available version, via yum

params.name: name
params.description: One or more package names, e.g. ["httpd"] or ["httpd", "curl"].

params.name: state
params.description: Desired package state. Default "present".

name: yum_repository
short_description: Ensure a yum/dnf repository definition (an INI-style [id] section) is present or absent in /etc/yum.repos.d/<file>.repo

params.name: baseurl
params.description: Repository base URL. Required for state=present.

params.name: description
params.description: Human-readable repo name (the .repo file's name= field).

params.name: enabled
params.description: Whether the repository is enabled. Default true.

params.name: file
params.description: Target file name (without .repo) under /etc/yum.repos.d/. Defaults to name.

params.name: gpgcheck
params.description: Whether to verify package signatures. Default true.

params.name: gpgkey
params.description: Optional URL to the repository's GPG key.

params.name: name
params.description: Repository id — the INI section header, e.g. "myrepo".

params.name: state
params.description: Whether the repository should be present or absent. Default "present".

name: community.general.yum_versionlock
short_description: Locks / unlocks a installed package(s) from being updated by yum package manager

params.name: name
params.description: Package name or a list of package names with optional version or wildcards. Specifying versions is supported since community.general 7.2.0.

params.name: state
params.description: If state is V(present), package(s) will be added to yum versionlock list. If state is V(absent), package(s) will be removed from yum versionlock list.

name: community.general.zfs
short_description: Manage zfs

params.name: extra_zfs_properties
params.description: A dictionary of zfs properties to be set. See the zfs(8) man page for more information.

params.name: name
params.description: File system, snapshot or volume name, for example V(rpool/myfs).

params.name: origin
params.description: Snapshot from which to create a clone.

params.name: state
params.description: Whether to create (V(present)), or remove (V(absent)) a file system, snapshot or volume. All parents/children will be created/destroyed as needed to reach the desired state.

name: community.general.zfs_delegate_admin
short_description: Manage ZFS delegated administration (user admin privileges)

params.name: descendents
params.description: Apply permissions to O(name)'s descendents (C(zfs allow -d)).

params.name: everyone
params.description: Apply permissions to everyone.

params.name: groups
params.description: List of groups to whom permission(s) should be granted.

params.name: local
params.description: Apply permissions to O(name) locally (C(zfs allow -l)).

params.name: name
params.description: File system or volume name, for example V(rpool/myfs).

params.name: permissions
params.description: The list of permission(s) to delegate (required if O(state=present)). Supported permissions depend on the ZFS version in use. See for example U(https://openzfs.github.io/openzfs-docs/man/8/zfs-allow.8.html) for OpenZFS.

params.name: recursive
params.description: Unallow permissions recursively (ignored when O(state=present)).

params.name: state
params.description: Whether to allow (V(present)), or unallow (V(absent)) a permission. When set to V(present), at least one "entity" param of O(users), O(groups), or O(everyone) are required. When set to V(absent), removes permissions from the specified entities, or removes all permissions if no entity params are specified.

params.name: users
params.description: List of users to whom permission(s) should be granted.

name: community.general.zfs_facts
short_description: Gather facts about ZFS datasets

params.name: depth
params.description: Specifies recursion depth.

params.name: name
params.description: ZFS dataset name.

params.name: parsable
params.description: Specifies if property values should be displayed in machine friendly format.

params.name: properties
params.description: Specifies which dataset properties should be queried in comma-separated format. For more information about dataset properties, check zfs(1M) man page.

params.name: recurse
params.description: Specifies if properties for any children should be recursively displayed.

params.name: type
params.description: Specifies which datasets types to display. Multiple values have to be provided in comma-separated form.

name: community.general.znode
short_description: Create, delete, retrieve, and update znodes using ZooKeeper

params.name: auth_credential
params.description: The authentication credential value. Depends on O(auth_scheme). The format for O(auth_scheme=digest) is C(user:password), and the format for O(auth_scheme=sasl) is C(user:password).

params.name: auth_scheme
params.description: Authentication scheme.

params.name: hosts
params.description: A list of ZooKeeper servers (format '[server]:[port]').

params.name: name
params.description: The path of the znode.

params.name: op
params.description: An operation to perform. Mutually exclusive with state.

params.name: recursive
params.description: Recursively delete node and all its children.

params.name: state
params.description: The state to enforce. Mutually exclusive with op.

params.name: timeout
params.description: The amount of time to wait for a node to appear.

params.name: use_tls
params.description: Using TLS/SSL or not.

params.name: value
params.description: The value assigned to the znode.

name: community.general.zpool_facts
short_description: Gather facts about ZFS pools

params.name: name
params.description: ZFS pool name.

params.name: parsable
params.description: Specifies if property values should be displayed in machine friendly format.

params.name: properties
params.description: Specifies which dataset properties should be queried in comma-separated format. For more information about dataset properties, check zpool(1M) man page.

name: community.general.zypper
short_description: Manage packages on SUSE and openSUSE

params.name: allow_vendor_change
params.description: Adds C(--allow_vendor_change) option to I(zypper) dist-upgrade command.

params.name: clean_deps
params.description: Adds C(--clean-deps) option to I(zypper) remove command.

params.name: disable_gpg_check
params.description: Whether to disable to GPG signature checking of the package signature being installed. Has an effect only if O(state) is V(present) or V(latest).

params.name: disable_recommends
params.description: Corresponds to the C(--no-recommends) option for I(zypper). Default behavior (V(true)) modifies zypper's default behavior; V(false) does install recommended packages.

params.name: extra_args
params.description: Add additional options to C(zypper) command. Options should be supplied in a single line as if given in the command line.

params.name: extra_args_precommand
params.description: Add additional global target options to C(zypper). Options should be supplied in a single line as if given in the command line.

params.name: force
params.description: Adds C(--force) option to I(zypper). Allows to downgrade packages and change vendor or architecture.

params.name: force_resolution
params.description: Adds C(--force-resolution) option to I(zypper). Allows to (un)install packages with conflicting requirements (resolver will choose a solution).

params.name: name
params.description: Package name V(name) or package specifier or a list of either. Can include a version like V(name=1.0), V(name>3.4) or V(name<=2.7). If a version is given, V(oldpackage) is implied and zypper is allowed to update the package within the version range given. You can also pass a url or a local path to a rpm file. When using O(state=latest), this can be '*', which updates all installed packages.

params.name: oldpackage
params.description: Adds C(--oldpackage) option to I(zypper). Allows to downgrade packages with less side-effects than force. This is implied as soon as a version is specified as part of the package name.

params.name: replacefiles
params.description: Adds C(--replacefiles) option to I(zypper) install/update command.

params.name: state
params.description: V(present) will make sure the package is installed. V(latest)  will make sure the latest version of the package is installed. V(absent)  will make sure the specified package is not installed. V(dist-upgrade) will make sure the latest version of all installed packages from all enabled repositories is installed. When using V(dist-upgrade), O(name) should be V('*').

params.name: type
params.description: The type of package to be operated on.

params.name: update_cache
params.description: Run the equivalent of C(zypper refresh) before the operation. Disabled in check mode.

name: community.general.zypper_repository
short_description: Add and remove Zypper repositories

params.name: auto_import_keys
params.description: Automatically import the gpg signing key of the new or changed repository. Has an effect only if O(state=present). Has no effect on existing (unchanged) repositories or in combination with O(state=absent). Implies runrefresh. Only works with C(.repo) files if `name` is given explicitly.

params.name: autorefresh
params.description: Enable autorefresh of the repository.

params.name: description
params.description: A description of the repository

params.name: disable_gpg_check
params.description: Whether to disable GPG signature checking of all packages. Has an effect only if O(state=present). Needs zypper version >= 1.6.2.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Set repository to enabled (or disabled).

params.name: name
params.description: A name for the repository. Not required when adding repofiles.

params.name: overwrite_multiple
params.description: Overwrite multiple repository entries, if repositories with both name and URL already exist.

params.name: priority
params.description: Set priority of repository. Packages will always be installed from the repository with the smallest priority number. Needs zypper version >= 1.12.25.

params.name: repo
params.description: URI of the repository or .repo file. Required when state=present.

params.name: runrefresh
params.description: Refresh the package list of the given repository. Can be used with repo=* to refresh all repositories.

params.name: state
params.description: A source string state.
